message.content:
**Overall Impression:** The layout is generally clean and well-structured, but suffers from inconsistent vertical alignment in the statistics row and a noticeable visual hierarchy imbalance due to the heavy background color on the first stat card.

### Visual QA Report

| Location | Issue | Severity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Statistics Row (Top)** | **Vertical Misalignment:** The text content (label and value) inside the first card ("2 مشاريع") is not vertically centered relative to the other three cards. It appears pushed downwards or the container height differs slightly. | P2 |
| **Statistics Row (First Card)** | **Inconsistent Styling:** The first stat card has a distinct beige background color (`#FFF8E1` approx) while the other three cards are white/transparent. This breaks visual consistency among sibling components of the same type. | P2 |
| **Project Cards Grid** | **Inconsistent Content Height:** The description text length varies significantly across the four project cards (e.g., "إدارة المواهب" vs "تحليل المنافسين"), causing the cards to have unequal heights and misaligned bottom action areas ("عرض المشروع"). | P3 |
| **Recent Files Table** | **Alignment Inconsistency:** The file type icons (folder/link icons) in the first column are not perfectly aligned vertically with each other or the text baseline, appearing to float at slightly different heights per row. | P3 |
| **Sidebar (Right)** | **Icon Alignment:** The active state indicator (green dot next to "نماذج") is centered vertically with the icon, but the text label "نماذج" appears slightly lower than the center axis compared to inactive menu items. | P3 |
